*New in v0.28.0: a creature of [the Underhearth](/world/underhearth/#creatures)’s Ashen Wilds, a tier 4 land.*

The barrow dead who fell into the deep and burn still. It fights like a Hollow (a raised shield, two blows in a row, a leap), but each blow that lands sets the hero **burning** for 2.5 seconds (5 health a second; a roll puts it out sooner) and, like a Hollow’s blade, carries grave rot (60% of hits: 12 seconds, 16 for a Thane), and it **bursts into flame** a moment after it falls: step out of the ring. It does not burn.

Its numbers are the Hollow’s: ×1.45 health, ×1.3 damage and ×1.12 speed. The death burst is a ring of 3.6 m after 1.2 seconds (an elite with the Volatile trait bursts in its stead).

## Health and poise

| Level | Variant | Easy / Builder health | Normal health | Hard / Hardcore health | Poise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Kindled | 107.3 | 118.03 | 139.49 | 42 |
| 2 | Kindled | 155.58 | 171.14 | 202.26 | 42 |
| 3 | Kindled Thane | 203.87 | 224.26 | 265.03 | 42 |

These are non-elite values before omens. Poise does not scale with creature level or difficulty. Creatures born in the outer lands are stronger by their land's danger tier (since v0.27.0): Birchwood and the coast **×1.35 health** and **×1.25 damage**, Elderwood and the Mire **×1.65** and **×1.45**, the Highlands and the Skerries **×1.9** and **×1.65**, with more poise, keener senses, a little more speed and elites more often; packs of Stalkers and spiders there hold one more. See [the lands' tiers](/biomes/). Base movement speed: **2.8 m/s**, before night, state, omen and elite modifiers.

## Attacks

| Attack | Base damage | Normal, level 1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First slash | 16.9 | 18.93 |
| Second slash | 14.3 | 16.02 |
| Leap | 26 | 29.12 |
| Death burst | 20.8 | 23.3 |

Damage = base × (1 + 0.3 × (level − 1)) × difficulty multiplier. Easy/Builder: ×1; Normal: ×1.12; Hard/Hardcore: ×1.35. This is outgoing hit damage before the hero’s armour, mitigation and other combat effects. Venom and grave rot are separate status effects.

## Damage types

| Kind of blow | Damage taken | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Crushing (clubs, fists) | ×1.5 | Weak |
| Cutting (blades, axes) | ×0.7 | Resists |
| Piercing (spears, arrows, picks) | ×1 | Normal |

A blow on a creature that has not noticed anyone is a **sneak attack**: ×3 damage, at most once every 5 minutes per creature. Exposed creatures take ×1.6 on top. See [Sneaking and damage types](/mechanics/#sneaking-and-damage-types).

## Elite and warden modifiers

Elite health is multiplied by 1.6, poise by 1.3 and outgoing damage by 1.15. Ironhide adds ×1.8 health and ×1.6 poise; Frenzied adds ×1.35 damage; Swift adds ×1.3 movement speed. Barrow wardens also apply their own health multiplier, ×1.6 poise and ×1.2 damage. These effects stack.

Elite loot is **additional** to the normal drops: one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/kindled-trophy/"><img src="/images/icons/kindledtrophy.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Kindled Trophy</a>, two <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/grave-iron/"><img src="/images/icons/graveiron.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Grave Iron</a>, plus one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/crystal/"><img src="/images/icons/crystal.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Echo Crystal</a> with 65% / 80% / 95% chance at level 1 / 2 / 3. The game uses the Stalker trophy for elite spiders too. Omens can add further drops.
